about: Default clip set, by Mixamo file hash in the jasongzy/Mixamo mirror (which names nothing). Locomotion was chosen by blender/scan_locomotion.py, which graded all 2,147 short clips on what a character controller needs: the body faces the way it travels (hips, shoulders and planted feet within a few degrees of the travel direction), the path is straight, the source feet do not slip, and the clip closes as a cycle. The previous run travelled at 45 degrees to its own facing and could not be planted by any rotation; the previous walk crabbed 13 degrees. Finalists were then retargeted and judged by eye on side and front filmstrips, because a clean score does not rule out a sneak, a zombie shamble or a sprint start. The jump starts and ends standing and tucks naturally; its long anticipation is handled by the manifest's entry_s. Replace any entry with your own Mixamo download to change the character's moves.
